ROLE OVERVIEW

We are looking for a forward-thinking and technically capable AI Marketing Operations Manager to build and support K3's AI-powered marketing operations capability within the Marketing Operations function at K3 Advisory Group. You will help drive the AI and automation strategy across the marketing department - spanning prompt engineering, AI tooling governance, automation workflows, and scaled content and data operations. Working closely with the Head of Marketing Operations and wider growth leadership, you will drive operational efficiency, accelerate delivery speed, and identify high-impact AI use cases that create measurable commercial advantage across K3's portfolio.

COMMERCIAL OBJECTIVES

• Profile-driven, AI-powered revenue orchestration (at scale)

• Addressable market coverage, brand awareness & brand engagement

• Multi-channel personalised engagement (brand + CEOs)

• Qualified lead volumes, opportunity CVR, revenue acceleration (at scale) - creating customer intelligence & decisioning

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Leadership & Management

• Intelligence layer: customer profile schema, ICP models, lead scoring models & intent models

• Automation - journey framework, trigger architecture, AI workflows & decision trees

• Commercial - pipeline acceleration, lead quality improvements, revenue attribution & personalisation performance

Functional Responsibilities

• You will own ICP modelling, persona development, behaviour modelling, lead scoring, intent scoring and opportunity scoring - building the intelligence that powers every downstream campaign.

• You will bring AI personalisation to life through dynamic content, dynamic journeys, dynamic sequencing, offer selection, message optimisation and next-best-action modelling.

• You will build and maintain the customer profile schema, working across audience segmentation, data enrichment, intent signals, behaviour signals and revenue signals.

• You will orchestrate journeys across email, SMS, paid media, website personalisation, sales enablement triggers and customer success triggers.

• You will own the AI personalisation programme end-to-end, from development requirements and roadmap through to the personalisation framework, audience intelligence model, revenue orchestration model and agentic workflow design.

• You will build and continuously optimise the customer profile schema, bringing together firmographic, contact, behavioural, financial and commercial data alongside intent signals.

• You will develop ICP models, buying committee models, sector propensity models, lookalike audiences and win propensity models to sharpen targeting across the business.

• You will design AI-driven orchestration systems where journeys never really end - each interaction shaping and improving what comes next through intelligent decision trees.

• You will build the logic behind AI-powered content decisioning, automating how email content, CTAs, offers, send timing and sequencing are selected based on ICP, behaviour, funnel stage, intent and engagement history.

• You will build intelligence models for lead, opportunity, expansion and churn scoring, giving the business a clear, predictive read on revenue.

• You will define the rules that govern the Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) intelligence layer - audience creation, journey entry/exit, suppression logic, personalisation logic and sales triggers.

• You will build autonomous AI agents and workflows, including content agents, journey agents, ICP agents and sales agents, to scale delivery without scaling headcount.

• You will connect AI activity to commercial outcomes through an attribution and revenue intelligence layer, tracking segment, journey, content and revenue performance.

• You will lead and develop your team, setting clear objectives and driving strong performance.

• You will own governance, compliance and AI quality - building the frameworks for data governance, AI governance, prompt governance, personalisation rules, consent compliance and auditability.

• You will keep your finger on the pulse of the AI landscape, tracking the latest platform trends and advances and using them to continuously improve the sophistication of K3's marketing AI set-up and tooling.

KEY PERFORMANCE MEASURES

• Coverage - personalisation coverage (reach in the millions), pipeline/revenue targets exceeded

• Quality - ICP profile completeness scores, ICP accuracy, CVR rate by segment, pipeline yield

• Quality - compliance, data quality, model accuracy, brand guardianship

• Pipeline - journey conversion, engagement increases, revenue generated

• Channel engagement - open rate, CTR, CVR rate, opportunity creation

• Revenue Ops - scoring accuracy, opportunity CVR, revenue predictability/influence, attribution accuracy

• Efficiency - productivity gains, manual effort reduction, pipeline contribution


WHAT WE OFFER

• Competitive salary, commensurate with experience and seniority

• Performance-related bonus linked to individual and business outcomes

• Hybrid and flexible working arrangements

• Structured professional development budget and learning opportunities

• Pension and healthcare options

• Exposure to a broad and diverse portfolio of professional services businesses across K3 Advisory Group

• A fast-paced, commercially driven environment with real scope for career progression


K3 Advisory Group is an equal opportunities employer. This job specification sets out the principal responsibilities for this role and is not an exhaustive list of duties. Responsibilities may evolve over time in line with the needs of the business.

As our Pre-sales AI Solutions Architect within the AI Practice, you'll combine technical leadership, client engagement and strategic thinking to help grow our AI capabilities across a wide range of UK sectors.   • Proven pre-sales experience, including authoring bids, developing proposals and helping secure new business opportunities.
  • Experience designing and delivering AI solutions within complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong knowledge of Artificial Intelligence technologies, including Machine Learning, Generative AI, AI Agents, AWS AI and Azure AI.
  • Experience developing AI-enhanced digital assistant solutions such as Microsoft Copilot.

It would be great if you had:

  • Experience working across multi-cloud environments, including AWS, Azure and Google Cloud Platform.
  • Familiarity with AI governance, responsible AI principles and ethical AI frameworks.

Job Description

This is an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and experienced Data Engineering team at AJ Bell, contributing significantly to the development of our state-of-the-art data platform using cutting-edge technology. As a Data Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, maintaining, and evolving our data infrastructure, ensuring it meets the growing needs of our business. You'll engage in end-to-end development, collaborate closely with key stakeholders and internal customers, and empower the organisation by enabling informed, data-driven decision-making.

What does the job involve?

The key responsibilities of the role are as follows:

  • Collaborating with stakeholders to identify and refine data requirements, ensuring data is accessibility and alignment with business needs.
  • Developing Data Warehousing solutions.
  • Automating extract, load and transform (ELT) pipelines that follow modern CI/CD practices.
  • Data Integration Design – Ensure development is scalable, efficient and future-proof.
  • Data Modelling – Producing clear data models where necessary.
  • Maintaining and continuously enhancing the data platform.
  • Provisioning data from various sources.
  • Create automated tests to ensure quality and integrity of data.
  • Ensure data is compliant with AJ Bell’s Data Governance and Data Classification policies.
  • Maintain data dictionary.
  • Maintain business level data model.
  • Recommending and introducing new technology where needed.

Core:

  • Cloud data platforms (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift)
  • Data transformation technology such as DBT
  • Visual Studio Code
  • Python
  • CI automation systems such as Jenkins
  • A git-based source control system such as BitBucket
  • Data Warehouse/Kimball methodology
  • Data replication technology such as Fivetran HVR.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication skills and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical teams

Other:

  • Good knowledge of IT products and systems
  • Good analytical skills
  • Excellent communication skills verbal and written
  • Able to communicate with people at all levels confidently and effectively
  • Able to prioritise work effectively
  • Customer focussed
  • Flexible approach to work - team player
  • Adaptable to changing environment
  • Self-motivated
  • Embraces continuous learning
  • Previous experience working in an e-commerce and/or financial services business
  • Ability to use Docker and container orchestration tools
  • AWS cloud infrastructure including AWS CDK
  • MS SQL
  • No SQL database such as Mongo
  • AI Tools such as CoPilot, Snowflake Cortex

At AJ Bell, we believe investing should feel good. Whether you're looking for an ISA, pension or dealing account, whether you want to invest with the help of a financial adviser or do it yourself, we have easy-to-use solutions to suit people from all walks of life.

We're one of the UK's fastest-growing investment platform businesses, trusted by everyone from professional financial advisers to first-time investors.

Today, over 762,000 customers trust us to manage more than £121.5 billion of assets. By continually striving to make investing simpler and more accessible, we're helping more people take control of their financial futures.

We're proud to be recognised as one of the UK's Best 100 Companies to Work For for six consecutive years, and a Great Place to Work in 2025 and 2026, a reflection of our supportive and collaborative culture.

  • 25 days holiday, increasing with service + buy/sell scheme + bank holidays
  • 6% Pension with matched contributions
  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • Share schemes (including free shares and BAYE)
  • Health Cash Plan and discounted private healthcare
  • Free onsite gym
  • Enhanced family leave (subject to qualifying criteria)
  • Travel and bike loan schemes
  • Employee Assistance Programme

Life at AJ Bell

  • Regular social events including summer and Christmas parties
  • Learning and development opportunities tailored to you
  • Casual dress code
  • Friendly, supportive team environment

Our ways of working

We offer hybrid working, with a minimum of 50% of your working time per month spent in the office.

For new starters, there’s an initial period of full-time office working to help you settle in and build relationships.

Inclusion & diversity

We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and able to be themselves at work.

We welcome applications from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential.

AI Implementer – Graduate Opportunity

£27,000 per annum pro rata

Part Time

Are you a recent graduate with a genuine interest in Artificial Intelligence and technology?

Do you enjoy finding smarter and more efficient ways of doing things?

Would you like the opportunity to help a business introduce AI into its everyday operations?

We are looking for a bright and inquisitive AI Implementer to join a Manchester-based business on a part-time basis. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate who understands the potential of AI and wants to gain practical experience implementing it within a real commercial environment.

The Role

This isn't a traditional IT or software development position. As AI Implementer, you will work with different areas of the business to understand existing processes and identify where AI and automation could save time, improve efficiency and enhance the way people work.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Reviewing existing business processes and identifying opportunities to use AI.
  • Researching and testing AI tools and applications.
  • Introducing practical AI solutions into everyday workflows.
  • Creating prompts, templates and repeatable AI processes.
  • Using AI to support administration, research, marketing and reporting.
  • Helping automate repetitive and time-consuming tasks.
  • Working with employees to understand where technology could make their jobs easier.
  • Training and supporting colleagues in the effective use of new AI tools.
  • Measuring the impact of new processes and recommending improvements.
  • Keeping up to date with developments in AI and emerging technology.
About You

We are particularly interested in a recent graduate who is naturally curious about AI and enjoys experimenting with new technology.

You will ideally have:

  • A degree in any relevant discipline.
  • A genuine interest in AI, automation and emerging technology.
  • Experience using tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot or similar AI platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Good Microsoft Excel and general IT skills.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • The confidence to explain technology to non-technical colleagues.
  • A practical, hands-on approach – someone who enjoys turning ideas into working solutions.

Programming experience is not essential. We are more interested in someone who understands how AI can be practically applied to improve a business.

What's on Offer?

£27,000 per annum pro rata, part-time hours and the opportunity to take ownership of an exciting AI implementation project within an established Preston business.

For the right graduate, this is an opportunity to build genuine commercial AI experience rather than simply studying the technology – identifying opportunities, implementing solutions and seeing the impact of their work.

We use our specialised Data Science Career programme which looks to assist, train and place qualified candidates into a career pathway in Data Science.

Our career program is designed for entry level individuals with limited or no experience. Please do not apply if you are already an experienced Data Analyst as we will be looking primarily at entry level roles.

Demand for candidates who are experts in working with Data and AI has grown 20% year on year with salaries of £50k+. Business decisions rely on data to ensure correct business decisions are made and the role of the data analyst in the new digital world is now essential for business owners.

Current average salaries in the sector for lower-level positions and fully trained Data Experts:

  • Junior Data Analyst - £30,000
  • Data Analyst - £50,000
  • Business Analysts - £60,000
  • Data Scientist - £65,000

Using our experience in providing data analysis and business analysis training online and through our expert recruitment consultants, we can provide a seamless journey and often fast-tracked route into a new career in Data Science.

Courses have been identified by our recruitment partners as industry standards for the Data Analysis sector.

Skills shortages across all sectors are increasing the demand for qualified, entry-level career seekers and career changers.

Working full-time, part-time or are unemployed, this job and recruitment package has the flexibility to be completed at a pace that suits you and can be completed in a few weeks.

Step 1 - Data Administration Training

Data is extracted using various method which are normally IT driven.

We provide you with access to the following courses to ensure you are employable as a data analyst.

  • Microsoft excel - to expert level.
  • Learn SQL - the programming language used for extracting data from more complex databases.
  • Learn Python 3 - Python 3 is a simple to use programming language used by many analysts.
  • Learn Tableau - Tableu is a tool which analysts use to build visually appealing dashboards for complex data making it easier for stakeholders to comprehend.

Study time for these courses is approx. 30-60 hours and qualification is through completion of the course with no exam.

Step 2 - CompTIA Data+ Qualification

The first step is completing the CompTIA Data+ Qualification accredited by CompTIA.

This professional international industry-recognised qualification teaches you the essential skills of a Data Analyst. You will cover skills such as data mining, manipulating data, visualising data, and reporting on data.

Study time for the qualification is approximately 30 hours and qualification achieved by completing a 1-hour exam.

The course is online and comes complete with exam simulators and revision tools.

You will have access to a tutor and a 1-hour online revision workshop prior to your exam.

This qualification sets you on course to becoming a data analyst.

Step 3 - Business Analysis Foundation

Business Analysts and Data Analysts often work very closely together and indeed many Data Analysts become Business Analysts and vice versa.

A Business Analyst Foundation certificate will make you more employable and enable you to cross over into Business Analyst roles. Business Analysis Foundation accredited by the BCS.

Study time is around 15 hours, and qualification is achieved by online exam.

Are you a qualified Secondary MFL teacher with a specialised background in German? Do you have a passion for educational technology, language pedagogy, and safeguarding?

We are looking for experienced German educators to join a vital national project. You will play a key role in building the benchmarks that ensure AI tutoring tools are safe, linguistically accurate, and pedagogically sound for students across the UK.

About the Role

This is a highly flexible, fully remote role running until 30th September 2026, requiring approximately 5-10 hours per week.

- Location: Fully Remote (UK)

- Hours: 5-10 hours per week (Flexible)

Key Requirements

Mandatory:

- Secondary Qualified Teacher Status (QTS) with verified experience teaching German in English schools (references required).

- Specific experience teaching Year 9 German.

- Comfortable using web-based platforms, working with German character sets (umlauts/Eszett), and adapting to new software.

- Your own laptop and a reliable internet connection.


Highly Valued (But Not Required):

- Safeguarding Expertise: Designated Safeguarding experience (e.g., current/former DSL or Deputy DSL, or Level 3+ safeguarding training with practical child protection responsibilities).

- SEND Experience: SENCO experience, working in a specialist school, or holding a recognised Level 3+ SEND qualification.


Desirable (But Not Required):

- 2+ years of experience delivering approved MFL teacher training (ITT, NPQs, ECF, etc.).

- 1+ years of 1:1 German tutoring experience with Year 9 students.

As Platform Product Owner you sit inside the Pod. The Platform Product Manager sets the strategy, the commercial case and the roadmap; you turn that into a clear, sequenced backlog of precise, buildable specifications, make the day-to-day trade-off calls that keep the Pod moving, and accept the work as it's delivered. You are the difference between a good brief and a good product.

Here's the part that makes platform work different: the platform is the foundation the rest of the business builds on, so your customers aren't only end users.   • Curate platform domain knowledge — Keep specs and platform context current as the platform evolves, working alongside the Architect and engineering.
  • Close the learning loop — Feed what the Pod learns during delivery back into the roadmap and sequencing.

  • Manchester - Hybrid working with a minimum of 1 day per week on-site (more as required)

  • Document findings, data issues and recommendations to support migration activities.

  • Previous experience as a Business Analyst or Data Analyst on data migration or transformation projects.

  • Experience identifying and documenting data issues, gaps and remediation requirements.

  • Excellent analytical, documentation and communication skills.
Desirable
  • Experience within Pensions, Life & Pensions or Financial Services.
  • Previous involvement in legacy system migrations or platform transformation programmes.
